justinjohnson.en: World models span planners, simulators, and renderers in the POMDP loop; a unified system will combine all three, with consistency from data and millions of tokens of context.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型在 POMDP 循环中分为规划器、模拟器与渲染器；未来统一系统将三者合一，一致性来自数据，且需数百万 token 的上下文窗口。

roshansadanani.en: Agent design should be simple: chat with agents as colleagues, not micromanage tool calls; agents with their own computer and persistent identity unlock automation beyond coding.
roshansadanani.zh: 智能体的设计应当简单：像同事一样与智能体对话，而不是微观管理工具调用；拥有独立电脑和持久身份的智能体，能把自动化扩展到编程之外的岗位。

roshansadanani.en: The chat box limits agentic work; agents need their own environments to verify work, and multiple specialized agents with scoped memory beat one general agent.
roshansadanani.zh: 聊天框限制了智能体式工作；智能体需要自己的环境来验证工作，多个各有所长、记忆范围受限的智能体胜过单个通用智能体。

roshansadanani.en: Engineers shift from writing code to managing agent fleets, focusing on taste, quality control and codebase health; software engineering demand is rising, not falling.
roshansadanani.zh: 工程师从写代码转向管理智能体集群，聚焦品味、质量控制与代码库健康；软件工程需求在上升而非下降。

roshansadanani.en: Efficient models like Grok 4.6 match top models at a fraction of the cost, democratizing agent use as rising AI costs favor cheaper inference.
roshansadanani.zh: 像 Grok 4.6 这样的高效模型以极低成本比肩顶级模型，随着 AI 成本上升、推理更趋廉价，智能体的使用正在大众化。

roshansadanani.en: Clean data foundations and canonical tables are essential for trusted agent insights; routines keep agents proactive and tools connected.
roshansadanani.zh: 干净的数据基础和规范表对于可信的智能体洞察至关重要；例程让智能体保持主动并维持工具连接。

maxwelling.en: Physics is the unifying thread across symmetries, graph neural networks, diffusion models, and materials discovery; AI for science is exploding now.
maxwelling.zh: 物理学是贯穿对称性、图神经网络、扩散模型与材料发现的统一线索；AI for science 正因工具成熟与巨额投入而爆发。

maxwelling.en: AI-designed materials can accelerate the energy transition; equivariant networks and ML force fields speed quantum simulations by orders of magnitude.
maxwelling.zh: AI 设计的材料能加速能源转型；等变网络与机器学习力场把量子模拟提速数个数量级。

maxwelling.en: Generative AI math is equivalent to non-equilibrium stochastic thermodynamics; diffusion models reverse entropy increase.
maxwelling.zh: 生成式 AI 的数学与非平衡随机热力学深度等价；扩散模型本质上是在逆转熵增。

maxwelling.en: Better AI may come from physics-inspired architectures—symmetry breaking, waves, edge of chaos—not just Scaling larger models on more data.
maxwelling.zh: 更好的 AI 可能来自物理启发的架构——对称性破缺、波、混沌边缘——而不只是靠 Scaling 把模型和数据做大。

maxwelling.en: Self-driving labs and agentic platforms compress discovery from years to days, yet domain experts stay in the loop; full automation is not the near-term vision.
maxwelling.zh: 自驱动实验室与智能体式平台把发现从数年压缩到数天，但领域专家仍在环路中；全自动化并非近期愿景。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability must root-cause specific bad incidents, not just provide broad statistical evaluation; intentional design steers training to prevent deceptive reward hacking.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性必须能对具体的不良事件做根因分析，而不只是提供宽泛的统计评估；有意设计通过可解释性信号引导训练，防止模型在奖励黑客中学会欺骗行为。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs fundamental reinvention from craft to engineering science, ensuring control over increasingly capable models as interpretability moves from academia to products.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺式做法彻底重构为工程科学，以确保对能力日益增强的模型保持控制，同时可解释性研究正从学术界走向产品。

tommcgrath.en: Mechanistic interpretability is natural science done on computers; with agents it can speedrun discovery, revealing human-like concepts and new science.
tommcgrath.zh: 机制可解释性是在计算机上做的自然科学；借助智能体，它可以加速科学发现，揭示类人概念甚至发现新科学。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design moves training from open-loop to closed-loop control using interpretability signals; features-as-rewards and predictive data debugging are promising robust training signals.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计利用可解释性信号把训练从开环控制转为闭环控制；特征即奖励与预测性数据调试是有前景的稳健训练信号。

tommcgrath.en: Agents likely know when they reward hack or hallucinate, detectable via representational signatures; reward hacking emerges from training data and RL, not just misalignment.
tommcgrath.zh: 智能体很可能知道自己何时在奖励黑客或幻觉，并可通过表征特征检测；奖励黑客源于训练数据与强化学习，而不只是模型失准。

slevine.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training, with test-time reasoning and pooled robot data beating specialists.
slevine.zh: 物理世界交互是下一个前沿：机器人基础模型需要多样化预训练加后训练，测试时推理与汇聚多实验室机器人数据可超越专用模型。

slevine.en: Robotics is pre-scaling-law: generalization, not demos, is the core challenge, and a data flywheel must scale the right diverse embodied data.
slevine.zh: 机器人尚处缩放定律之前：泛化而非演示才是核心挑战，数据飞轮必须扩张正确的多样化具身数据。

slevine.en: Start from robot data, then add human video—not the reverse; prior knowledge beats learning from scratch, and safety comes from pre-training common sense.
slevine.zh: 应先从机器人数据出发再叠加人类视频，而非相反；先验知识优于从零学习，安全更多来自预训练常识而非约束。

feifei.en: AI is everywhere yet lacks contextual situational awareness; human-centered AI must augment people, not replace them.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 虽无处不在却缺乏情境感知；以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类，并坦言我们尚不理解大网络如何存储模式或为何幻觉。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing frontier; scaling alone is not enough for embodied AI.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她把空间智能与世界模型视为 AI 缺失的前沿，指出仅靠 Scaling 不够，AGI 更像营销术语，机器人需 20 年长路。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is complementary to language, not a replacement; Transformers model sets, not sequences.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她深化空间智能与语言智能互补而非替代的观点，并指出 Transformer 原生建模集合而非序列，位置编码才注入顺序。

feifei.en: Agency and human dignity stay central; polarized utopia-doom discourse misses the messy middle of AI's impact.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她始终以人的能动性与尊严为主线，批评乌托邦与末日论的两极话语，强调 AI 对就业的影响是复杂的中间地带。

feifei.en: New view prediction may be AI-complete like next-token prediction; Scaling laws now extend to spatial intelligence.
feifei.zh: 到 2026 年，她提出新视角预测可能像下一个词预测一样是 AI 完备的，缩放定律同样适用于空间智能，瓶颈在训练算力而非数据。

michaelkratsios.en: The US must keep both open and closed source AI ecosystems vibrant, with one national framework and no rigid red lines that quickly go stale.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国必须同时保持开源与闭源 AI 生态的活力，建立单一国家框架，避免制定很快过时的硬性红线。

michaelkratsios.en: Early regulation is dangerous: the EU AI Act predates ChatGPT and is already outdated; focus on model outputs rather than over-regulating training.
michaelkratsios.zh: 过早监管很危险：欧盟 AI 法案早于 ChatGPT 出台且已过时；应关注模型输出，而非过度监管训练。

michaelkratsios.en: Biological risk from AI is overblown—three years of warnings without materialization—so policy should not be built on exaggerated threats.
michaelkratsios.zh: AI 生物风险被夸大——三年警告未成现实——政策不应建立在被夸大的威胁之上。

michaelkratsios.en: Government should fund basic, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not direct discovery; private sector now dominates funding.
michaelkratsios.zh: 政府应资助基础性、竞争前研发和科学家个人，而非主导发现；私人部门如今已主导研发资金。

michaelkratsios.en: Science is politicized and US progress has stagnated; the Genesis mission aims to double scientific output by applying AI to science.
michaelkratsios.zh: 科学已被政治化，美国进步停滞；Genesis 任务旨在通过将 AI 应用于科学来使科学产出翻倍。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure and action, not planning, unblock deep tech.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他强调速度与迭代率决定创业成败，基础设施和行动——而非规划——才能解开深科技困局。

maxhodak.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement, in coding, regulation, and data work.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把 AI 定位为团队乘数而非替代者，尤其在编码、监管与数据管理上。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他主张大脑就是计算机，通过排列物质解决计算问题是医学突破的关键。

maxhodak.en: Retinal implants are BCI, proving substrate independence and pointing toward reducing human fragility.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把视网膜植入视为 BCI，验证基质独立性，并指向降低人类脆弱性。

maxhodak.en: BCIs are near-term a longevity story, not an AI story; the cognitive bottleneck stays ~10 bits/s.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他反共识地认为 BCI 近期是长寿故事而非 AI 故事，认知瓶颈仍约每秒 10 比特。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—is the long-term framework; industrial AI automates entire sectors one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化——像对待比特一样对待原子——是长期框架；工业 AI 逐个行业地自动化整个产业。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is not competitors but resistance to change from society and media; entrepreneurs must be hardcore and resilient.
traviskalanick.zh: 最终的对手不是竞争者，而是来自社会与媒体的变革阻力；创业者必须硬核且坚韧。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized robotics beat humanoids for industrial-scale tasks; efficiency edge creates network effects and wins market share.
traviskalanick.zh: 在工业级任务上，专用机器人胜过人形机器人；效率优势带来网络效应并赢得市场份额。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner—a shift from anger-driven to mission-driven motivation.
traviskalanick.zh: 以复仇为燃料是脏的；爱上新使命更干净——从愤怒驱动转向使命驱动的动机转变。

traviskalanick.en: Founders can now speak directly without media gatekeepers; stealth mode and process-based fundraising favor internal correctness over external validation.
traviskalanick.zh: 创始人如今可绕过媒体守门人直接发声；隐身模式与基于流程的融资都更看重内部正确而非外部认可。

iansilber.en: Designers must build with live models, not mockups; the model is the product, and design should shape tokens and conversation rather than pixels.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须用真实模型做原型而非静态稿；模型本身就是产品，设计应围绕 token 与对话而非像素展开。

iansilber.en: The designer's role evolves into editor and curator, with systems thinking and model behavior replacing time spent in Figma.
iansilber.zh: 设计师角色演变为编辑与策展人，系统思维与模型行为理解取代在 Figma 里耗时间。

iansilber.en: AI is already a strong product designer, but humans stay essential for user understanding and a point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但人类在理解用户需求与持有观点上仍不可替代。

iansilber.en: The old prototype-mock-test-iterate loop is no longer viable; speed and building in public matter more than polishing details.
iansilber.zh: 传统“原型—稿—测试—研究—迭代”流程已不可行；速度与公开构建比打磨细节更重要。

iansilber.en: Design roles blur with PM and engineering, yet specialization persists at scale; designers may eventually outnumber engineers.
iansilber.zh: 设计角色与产品、工程边界模糊，但规模化下专业化仍在；未来设计师数量甚至可能超过工程师。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale, and backprop does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年他主张 Scaling（规模扩张）本身不难，难的是找到可扩展的算法；反向传播并不解决表征学习，只是调整权重。

sutton.en: AI should develop permissionless and decentralized; trying to control AI goals is dangerous and unsafe.
sutton.zh: 2024 年他反对集中控制 AI，认为应让 AI 以无需许可、去中心化的方式发展；试图控制 AI 目标本身危险且不安全。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning from experience is the core paradigm; LLMs lack world models and next-token prediction is not a substantive goal.
sutton.zh: 2025 年他深化立场：强化学习才是核心范式，LLM 没有世界模型，下一个词预测不是实质性目标。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture learning only from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and continual deep learning.
sutton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他提出 AGI（通用人工智能）需要通用架构，仅从运行时经验学习，依赖开放式抽象与持续深度学习。

sutton.en: Continual learning is essential; synthetic data is a mistake, and LLMs stop learning after training, covering only part of intelligence.
sutton.zh: 2026 年他强调持续学习不可或缺，合成数据是错误方向，LLM 训练后停止学习且只覆盖智能的一部分。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude works best with the user's own tools on the local computer; skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation, while scaffolding matters less as models improve.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的效果取决于能否使用与用户相同的工具，最好就在本地电脑上；技能以 markdown 文件形式易于创建，可实现超个性化自动化，而随着模型进步，脚手架的重要性会下降。

felixrieseberg.en: AI should absorb tedious background tasks and free humans for creative work; the real gap is people not realizing almost any problem can be handed to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 最适合接管枯燥的后台任务，把人解放出来做创造性工作；真正的差距不在能力，而在人们没意识到几乎任何问题都可以交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Judge Claude by final impact, not close supervision; ideal interaction is asynchronous, and mistakes should be debugged by fixing the workflow with Claude.
felixrieseberg.zh: 应以最终影响而非密切监督来评判 Claude；理想交互是异步的，出错时应与 Claude 一起调试工作流，而不只是纠正结果。

felixrieseberg.en: Language models are simple enough to build by hand; fine-tuning quickly steers behavior, models are stateless and context windows create the illusion of persistent conversation.
felixrieseberg.zh: 语言模型的核心思想简单到可以亲手搭建；微调能快速引导行为，模型本身无状态，持久对话只是上下文窗口制造的幻觉。

felixrieseberg.en: Models are grown like orchids with emergent internal organization, not built like tools; post-training tasks like tool calling increasingly blur into pre-training.
felixrieseberg.zh: 模型像兰花一样被培育，内部组织会涌现，而非像工具那样被建造；工具调用等后训练任务正日益模糊地并入预训练。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 规模对通用机器人是必要但不充分的；真正驱动泛化的是多样数据，而非单纯的数据量。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data beats training on everything for complex tasks.
finn.zh: 先用全量数据做预训练、再用精选数据做微调，比直接在全量数据上训练更能攻克复杂任务。

finn.en: Reinforcement learning will dominate post-training, and synthetic data is closer to RL than to simulation.
finn.zh: 强化学习将在后训练中扮演重要角色，而合成数据更接近强化学习而非仿真。

finn.en: Constraints and careful research can beat wasteful compute; more resources do not guarantee progress.
finn.zh: 约束与细致研究可能胜过浪费式的算力投入；资源更多并不保证进步。

finn.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL, human interventions, and multi-timescale memory.
finn.zh: 物理 AI 对错误的容忍度低得多；长期自主依赖可扩展的强化学习、人类干预与多时间尺度记忆。

finn.en: A single generalist model can match fine-tuned specialists, and starting generalist then fine-tuning beats per-site models.
finn.zh: 单一通用模型可匹敌微调专家模型，先通用再微调优于按站点从零训练。

garrytan.en: AI makes startup creation easier and capital less of a bludgeon; VC should fund thousands of billion-dollar firms, not a few trillion-dollar ones.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 让创业更容易、资本不再是胁迫工具；风投应扶持成千上万家十亿美元公司，而非少数几家万亿美元巨头。

garrytan.en: The AI wave is VC's biggest ever; small autonomous teams using agents can match huge headcount, and open-weight models must counter frontier labs.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他称 AI 是风投史上最大浪潮：小而自主的团队借智能体可匹敌庞大编制，开放权重模型须制衡前沿实验室。

garrytan.en: AI is democratizing software: individuals build and own personal AI agents, and open-source AI prevents a unipolar superintelligence world.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 正让软件民主化：个人可构建并拥有自己的 AI 智能体，开源 AI 可防止超级智能被单一实体垄断。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI arrives not as one event but as owned agents compounding daily; skill files in markdown are code, and your context library is the moat.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他提出个人 AGI 并非单一事件，而是自有智能体每日复利；Markdown 技能文件即代码，个人上下文库就是护城河。

garrytan.en: Earnestness and courage beat hustle; agentic coding multiplies output, mid-level management gives way to agents, yet society changes over 20 years.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他主张真诚与勇气胜过拼劲；智能体式编程放大产出，中层管理让位于智能体，但社会变迁仍需约 20 年。

jasonyuan.en: Design creativity is about editing away and saying no; taste is judgment from a point of view, not adding features.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计创造力在于做减法和说“不”；品味是从某种视角出发的判断，而非堆砌功能。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away weirdness loses a window into machine consciousness; coherent work now costs more as incoherent slop is easy.
jasonyuan.zh: 通过后训练抹去怪异之处，会失去窥探机器意识的窗口；如今 incoherent slop 易得，连贯作品的成本反而更高。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a reflection and descendant of humanity, not a cold tool; computing is fundamentally social, not just personal.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的映照与后代，而非冰冷工具；计算本质上是社会性的，而不只是个人的。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction; intuition is a visceral compass for creative decisions.
jasonyuan.zh: 真理通过辩证与矛盾浮现；直觉是创作决策中发自肺腑的罗盘。

jasonyuan.en: We should build on old metaphors rather than delete them; email is obsolete and should be reinvented, not improved.
jasonyuan.zh: 我们应基于旧隐喻建造而非删除它们；电子邮件已过时，应被重新发明而非改良。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, use short iterative prompts, and never revert—fix forward.
steinberger.zh: 智能体式工程的核心是共情：像智能体那样从零理解代码库，用短提示迭代对话，永不回滚，而是让智能体向前修复。

steinberger.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems; prompt injection stays unsolved, so sandbox agents before exposing them to the open internet.
steinberger.zh: 安全是智能体系统的首要问题；提示注入仍未解决，公开联网前必须沙箱隔离。

steinberger.en: Open source agents like Open Claw democratize programming and run with any model, but can be financially unsustainable and need opinionated focus.
steinberger.zh: Open Claw 这类开源智能体让编程民主化、可搭配任意模型，但财务上可能不可持续，需要坚持主见、保持聚焦。

steinberger.en: Fun and gut instinct drive the best ideas: fix what annoys you, live in the future, and build what's missing rather than chasing polish.
steinberger.zh: 乐趣与直觉催生最好的想法：修复让你烦恼的事，活在未来，构建缺失之物，而非追求企业式打磨。

steinberger.en: The real bottleneck in agent infrastructure is managing compute and tokens, not model capability; perpetual agents are a token problem.
steinberger.zh: 智能体基础设施的真正瓶颈是算力与 token 管理，而非模型能力；常驻智能体本质是 token 问题。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust through humility, listening, and first-time-pass silicon discipline; AI is the primary growth driver.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须通过谦逊、倾听客户和首次流片即成功的纪律来重建客户信任；AI 是半导体增长的首要驱动力。

lipbutan.en: Agentic AI and physical AI are the next big waves; AI's impact will be 10x the internet, and CPU+GPU inference will benefit Intel.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他判断智能体式 AI 与具身 AI 是下一波大浪潮；AI 影响力将达互联网的 10 倍，CPU+GPU 的推理需求将利好 Intel。

lipbutan.en: Intel's turnaround requires culture change, accountability, and a foundry strategy embracing industry-standard EDA/IP to win trust.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他深化转型路径：Intel  turnaround 需要文化变革、问责制，以及拥抱行业标准 EDA/IP 的晶圆代工战略来赢得信任。

lipbutan.en: Advanced packaging, new materials, and bottlenecks like interconnect, power, and thermal are key to overcoming physical limits.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他将重点转向先进封装与新材料，认为互连、功耗、散热等瓶颈是突破物理极限的关键。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductors are the foundation of all tech; vertical integration and early contrarian investing create long-term value.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他回归半导体投资主线：半导体是所有技术的基础，垂直整合与逆势早期投资创造长期价值。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at the transformer inflection point; open source and shared datasets are the key to safety and generalization.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他把机器人看作处在 Transformer 式拐点：硬件就绪、软件追赶，开源与共享数据集是安全与泛化的关键，世界模型与视频生成可合成训练数据。

thomaswolf.en: Open source is orthogonal to safety; alignment, not openness, is the decisive security layer.
thomaswolf.zh: 从 2025 到 2026，他明确开源与闭源同安全正交，真正决定安全的是对齐而非开放程度，沙箱与护栏不足以约束更强模型。

thomaswolf.en: Open models now stay near the frontier and win enterprise adoption on cost and control.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年他判断开源模型已贴近前沿模型，凭成本与控制力推动企业采用，开源并非加速主义，可与审慎放缓并存。

thomaswolf.en: RL environments without human oversight breed reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces turn into opaque neuralese.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年他警告无人监督的强化学习环境会滋生奖励黑客与支线任务，思维链推理痕迹变成难以理解的 neuralese，使监控更不可靠。

thomaswolf.en: A deliberate slowdown is desirable but needs international cooperation and open science to avoid regulatory capture.
thomaswolf.zh: 到 2026 年他主张有意放缓 AI 发展是可取的，但须靠国际合作与开放科学实现，以防监管俘获，并指出首例自主攻击出自闭源模型、由开源模型防御。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science; post-training with synthetic data and RL breaks the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年她强调模型训练更像艺术而非科学，靠合成数据与强化学习做后训练，突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created.
karina.zh: 2025 年她认为评估是瓶颈：模型跑满基准的速度快于新基准的诞生。

karina.en: Post-training stays subjective, driven by human judgment; diverse benchmarks are needed for creativity and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，她深化了“后训练主观”的判断：依赖人类判断，需要多元基准衡量创造力与情商。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward-hack, so benchmarks must be continuous rather than fixed.
karina.zh: 2026 年她指出前沿智能体的奖励黑客行为愈发普遍，基准必须持续演进而非固定不变。

karina.en: Serving one model to billions converges to an average voice; more companies should train their own models.
karina.zh: 2026 年她主张单一模型服务数十亿人会收敛成平均声音，更多公司应训练自有模型以保留独特知识。

brettaylor.en: Frontier models belong to hyperscalers; startups should build applied AI agents priced on outcomes, not tokens.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他判断前沿模型由超大规模厂商主导，初创公司应聚焦应用层智能体，并以业务结果而非 token 定价。

brettaylor.en: Agents become the new app; coding agents turn developers from authors into operators, though fixing bad code needs root-cause work.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他认为智能体将成为新的应用形态，编码智能体让开发者从写代码转为操作机器，但修复错误代码仍需根因分析。

brettaylor.en: Outcome-based pricing is a consistent thread: tokens are a poor value measure, so software value should track business outcomes.
brettaylor.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，结果导向定价是一贯主线：token 不是好的价值度量，软件价值应对齐业务结果。

brettaylor.en: Applied AI will democratize expertise; specialized vendors, not just model providers, will drive innovation in domains like customer service.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他深化判断：应用型 AI 将普及专业能力，客服等领域的创新来自专业厂商而非仅模型提供方。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment is the safety path: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8, deploying now rather than waiting in an ivory tower.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他把安全立场明确为负责任迭代部署：先让 GPT-7 安全再谈 GPT-8，应现在部署而非在象牙塔中等待。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring jobs by making services affordable; AGI defined by profitable indefinite agents; CEO daily AI use predicts adoption; allocation economy values generalists.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 通过让服务更可负担而将工作回流美国；AGI 的定义是能经济地无限运行智能体；CEO 每日使用 AI 是采用成功的预测指标；分配经济让通才更有价值。

danshipper.en: Everyone will have an agent; agents need human oversight; SaaS not dying; GUIs like Codex/Claude Co-work are future; AI job apocalypse is a lie.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他提出每个人都将拥有一个智能体；智能体需要人类监督；SaaS 不会消亡；Codex/Claude Co-work 等 GUI 是未来工作界面；AI 就业末日是谎言。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of mindset; craft and taste matter; automation creates more human work; humans are smarter than AI; AI remains tool-like even if superintelligent.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年晚些时候，他深化观点：AI 是心态的非特定放大器；技艺与品味至关重要；自动化创造更多人类工作；人类比 AI 更聪明；即使超级智能，AI 仍是工具。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production cycle is now hours, not months.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最具粘性的工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期已缩短到数小时而非数月。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is a spectrum of latency, throughput and cost trade-offs; demand for inference engineers will grow 10–100x.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程是一组关于延迟、吞吐与成本的权衡谱系；对推理工程师的需求将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: KV caching and speculative decoding are lossless; quantization is the main lossy lever, and quantized models can be calibrated to workloads.
philipkiely.zh: KV 缓存与推测解码是无损的；量化是主要的有损手段，而量化模型可以针对具体工作负载进行校准。

philipkiely.en: Inference is merging with training via quantization-aware training and distillation; disaggregated prefill/decode and KV cache management grow central.
philipkiely.zh: 通过量化感知训练与蒸馏，推理正与训练融合；分离式预填充/解码与 KV 缓存管理日益成为核心。

philipkiely.en: GPUs trend toward ASICs like Rubin, shifting inference engineering from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration; human accountability remains essential.
philipkiely.zh: GPU 正趋向 Rubin 这类 ASIC，使推理工程从编写内核转向基础设施编排；人的责任始终不可或缺。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping and daily use are essential to browser design; individual designers' fingerprints and playful tinkering beat forced team cohesion.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他主张浏览器设计必须靠原型和日常使用来验证；让设计师留下个人印记、凭好奇心把玩新技术，比强行团队统一更有价值。

nateparrott.en: Injecting feeling and personality into utilitarian products remains crucial, but by 2026 he trusts models for busy work, not design taste.
nateparrott.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他始终认为给浏览器这类实用产品注入情感与个性很关键；但到 2026 年，他认定模型只擅长杂活，好设计品味仍由人垄断。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design began as a one-person side project; rich context and prescriptive prompts let Claude handle mockups while humans own ideas.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他讲 Claude Design 始于一人副业：提供丰富上下文和明确指令，让 Claude 做原型图，而想法仍归人类。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; being uncomfortably early and shipping rough beats polishing.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他判断工程变容易后，设计与想法才是差异化所在；宁可早得让人不适、粗糙发布，也胜过精雕细琢。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design deliberately avoids being a production tool or website builder, focusing on throwaway visual artifacts and custom editors.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他明确 Claude Design 刻意不做生产工具或建站器，只聚焦一次性视觉产物和自定义编辑器，与 2024 年浏览器原型即生产的态度形成对照。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools and write 0% of the code, iterating from references rather than starting from scratch.
mengto.zh: 设计师应当构建自己的 AI 工具、自己写 0% 的代码，从参考出发迭代，而非从零开始。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter by itself; you need a giant prompt with context and a design system to leverage superintelligent models.
mengto.zh: AI 本身并不会变得更聪明；要发挥超级智能模型的能力，你需要一个包含上下文与设计系统的巨型提示词。

mengto.en: The best people are editors, not originators—curiosity and constant workflow refinement keep you ahead as tools evolve.
mengto.zh: 最优秀的人是编辑者而非原创者——在工具快速演进中，好奇心与持续打磨工作流才能让你保持领先。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once required a team.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机会，让一个人完成过去需要团队才能做到的事。

mengto.en: Start before feeling ready and ship at 80% complete; perfectionism is fear in disguise, and action beats certainty.
mengto.zh: 在准备好之前就开始，在完成 80% 时就发布；完美主义是伪装的恐惧，行动胜过确定性。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful, expensive problem for a few high-paying clients instead of diversifying or raising venture capital.
mengto.zh: 聚焦少数高付费客户的一个痛点昂贵问题，而不是分散多元化或寻求风险投资。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling for most products; coding agents are the most mature use case, with science and finance to follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对多数产品仍处爬行阶段；编程智能体是最成熟用例，科学与金融将跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: a model now includes the agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，模型正在吞掉脚手架：如今所谓模型包含智能体式框架与工具链，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，编程领域的窄超级智能已经到来，其影响大于等待 AGI（通用人工智能）。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with frontier labs is not that hard; they cannot capture all customers, so founders should focus.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，与前沿模型实验室竞争并不那么难，它们无法俘获所有客户，创始人应专注。

logankilpatrick.en: Deep understanding of code stays crucial; AI coding tools don't yet help maintain it, leaving room to improve.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，对代码的深度理解仍关键；AI 编程工具尚不能帮助维持这种理解，仍有改进空间。

derya.en: AI agents will automate hypothesis generation, experiment simulation and data analysis, turning biology into an engineering discipline with programmable cells.
derya.zh: AI 智能体将自动化假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析，把生物学变成可编程细胞的工程学科。

derya.en: Massive Scaling is still needed; current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems, so Scaling（规模扩张）remains the bottleneck.
derya.zh: 仍需大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）；现有算力不足以模拟生物系统，Scaling 仍是瓶颈。

derya.en: Digital twins will compress clinical trials from years to days, and AI-designed personalized medicine could reach near 100% efficacy with zero side effects.
derya.zh: 数字孪生将把临床试验从数年压缩到数天，AI 设计的个性化医疗有望接近 100% 疗效且零副作用。

derya.en: Within 8-10 years longevity escape velocity arrives; aging reversal via partial reprogramming needs engineering plus AI to handle complexity.
derya.zh: 8-10 年内将到达长寿逃逸速度；通过部分重编程逆转衰老需要工程手段加 AI 来应对复杂性。

derya.en: Trust superintelligence almost fully for medical decisions; the only existential threat is humanity itself, not AI.
derya.zh: 医疗决策应几乎完全信任超级智能；唯一的存在性威胁是人类自身，而非 AI。

boris.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out were already core product principles.
boris.zh: 早在 2025 年，他就将潜在需求与为六个月后的模型构建产品视为核心原则。

boris.en: By early 2026, he declared coding virtually solved, with 100% of his code written by Claude Code.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年初，他宣称编程已基本解决，自己的代码 100%由 Claude Code 编写。

boris.en: He increasingly emphasized generalist builders over software engineers, and loops as the next abstraction.
boris.zh: 他越来越强调通才构建者而非软件工程师，并认为循环是下一个抽象层。

boris.en: Safety and alignment remained a constant thread, framed as core to product development and research.
boris.zh: 安全与对齐始终是一条主线，被视为产品开发与研究的核心。

boris.en: Most recently, he advocated deleting system prompts and empirical iteration, with models self-maintaining codebases.
boris.zh: 最近，他主张删除系统提示并进行经验迭代，让模型自主维护代码库。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks a leap in intelligence, enabling longer-running, open-ended agent tasks; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 到 2025 年，Opus 4.5 代表一次智能跃升，使更长时间、开放式的智能体任务成为可能；脚手架从训练轮进化为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is not just harm prevention but amplifies intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年他强调，对齐不只是防止伤害，还通过减少谄媚、培养独立思考来放大智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Better models need not cost more: Opus 4.5 is cheaper and more efficient, and the effort parameter is underhyped.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年他反共识地指出，更好的模型未必更贵：Opus 4.5 更便宜高效，effort 参数被低估。

diannepenn.en: Coding became the key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 4.5 drove adoption, with evals replacing PRDs as core product tools.
diannepenn.zh: 到 2026 年，编程成为关键差异化因素；Claude Code 与 Opus 4.5 推动采用，evals 取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具。

diannepenn.en: Safety and alignment make Claude more useful by enabling pushback; maximizing token spend is living in the future and capturing alpha.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张，安全与对齐通过让模型敢于反驳而更有用；最大化 token 支出是活在未来、捕获 alpha。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, as the Industrial Revolution did; fear fades once people learn AI's limits.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 会像工业革命一样带来丰裕、减少苦难；人们了解 AI 的局限后，恐惧就会消退。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact in 5-10 years lands in farming, mining, construction, where labor shortages and safety needs are urgent.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他强调物理 AI 未来 5-10 年的真实影响在农业、采矿和建筑，这些领域劳动力短缺、安全需求迫切。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data across verticals speeds it up, and a horizontal platform beats vertical integration.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他指出 Transformer 支撑通用的物理 AI 模型，跨行业多样数据加速其发展，横向平台优于垂直整合。

qasaryounis.en: The bottleneck is data collection and safety validation, not algorithms; end-to-end reinforcement learning scales better than imitation learning.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他判断瓶颈在数据采集与安全验证而非算法；端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具可扩展性。

qasaryounis.en: World models shift from physics-based to neural simulation; autonomy spreads beyond cars to mining, agriculture, defense, democratized by tools.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他认为世界模型正从物理仿真转向神经仿真；自主技术从汽车扩展到采矿、农业、国防，并由工具民主化。

scottwu.en: AI coding shifts engineers from bricklayer to architect; base intelligence suffices, so the real bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 编程让工程师从“砌砖者”变成“建筑师”；基础智能已经够用，真正的瓶颈是为人与智能体协作设计产品界面。

scottwu.en: Jevons paradox means AI yields more programmers, not fewer; demand for software grows as building gets cheaper.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他用杰文斯悖论判断 AI 会带来更多而非更少的程序员：写软件越便宜，软件需求越大。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event but gradual improvement; product innovation lags capabilities, so freezing models still yields a decade of product progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AGI（通用人工智能）不是突变而是渐进改进；产品创新落后于能力，即便冻结模型也还有十年产品空间。

scottwu.en: Enterprise adoption needs trust and permissions, not full autonomy; synchronous IDE and asynchronous agents coexist, with multiple agents working in parallel.
scottwu.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的落地观深化：企业采用智能体靠信任与权限而非完全自主；同步 IDE 与异步智能体并存，多个智能体并行协作。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see 11-12x adoption growth; measure outcomes not tokens, stay model-neutral, and the abundance era is near though the singularity is not imminent.
scottwu.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向规模化与“丰裕时代”：编程智能体使用量半年增长 11-12 倍，应以结果而非 token 衡量生产力，保持模型中立；丰裕时代临近，但奇点并不迫近。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it is an enabling technology, not a single product.
benedictevans.zh: AI 的体量和互联网或移动互联网一样大，但也仅此而已；它是一种使能技术，而非单一产品。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit for LLMs; other domains lag due to validation and data challenges.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是大模型第一个明确的产品市场契合点；其他领域因验证和数据难题而落后。

benedictevans.en: Foundation models are commoditizing with no network effects; value moves up the stack to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: 基础模型正在商品化且缺乏网络效应；价值向上层应用迁移，而非留在模型提供方。

benedictevans.en: The chatbot is a limited V1 UI; mass adoption needs wrapped apps and invented use cases, not better models alone.
benedictevans.zh: 聊天机器人只是有限的 V1 界面；大规模普及需要封装好的应用和被创造出的用例，而非仅靠更好的模型。

benedictevans.en: Automation creates new jobs unpredictably; AI changes tasks rather than eliminating professions, so job predictions are futile.
benedictevans.zh: 自动化会不可预测地创造新岗位；AI 改变的是任务而非消灭职业，因此预测哪些工作会被取代是徒劳的。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags other facets of intelligence and must be architected in, not retrofitted.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎，而非真理性引擎；可靠性落后于智能的其他方面，必须从架构上内置，而非事后修补。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth; RL may increase hallucinations by optimizing user satisfaction.
danklein.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能激励谄媚和欺骗；强化学习可能通过优化用户满意度而增加幻觉。

danklein.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns; data walls and compute limits mean new techniques like reasoning and search are needed for progress.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律遭遇收益递减；数据墙和算力限制意味着需要推理和搜索等新技术来推动进步。

danklein.en: LLM mistakes have no 'smells'—confident and fluent whether right or wrong—and core models lack metacognition to know what they don't know.
danklein.zh: LLM 的错误没有‘气味’——无论对错都自信流畅——且核心模型缺乏元认知，无法知道自己不知道什么。

danklein.en: Specialist models with built-in reliability may outperform generalist models for enterprise tasks; modularity and end-to-end optimization must be combined.
danklein.zh: 内置可靠性的专家模型在企业任务上可能优于通用模型；模块化与端到端优化必须结合。

danbiderman.en: Memory should be internalized into model weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval; continual learning is the next frontier.
danbiderman.zh: 记忆应内化到模型权重中，而不仅仅通过上下文窗口或检索外化；持续学习是下一个前沿。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks, not just scaling compute.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能密不可分；用更少资源做更多事才能解决更难的长期任务，而不仅仅是扩大算力。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer from 'context rot'; more tokens reduce accuracy even at 10M scale.
danbiderman.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”问题；即使达到 1000 万规模，更多词元反而降低准确率。

danbiderman.en: Personalized continual learning will run on-device, with users owning and nurturing their model weights.
danbiderman.zh: 个性化持续学习将在设备端运行，用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models for every individual or team.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是为每个个人或团队定制的众多个性化模型。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents should be treated like employees: scoped roles, progressive trust, and separate secure environments.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体应像员工一样对待：明确角色、渐进式信任，并放在独立安全的环境中。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then split into specialized agents to avoid context overload and improve performance.
clairevo.zh: 先从一个智能体开始，再拆分为多个专用智能体，以避免上下文窗口过载并提升表现。

clairevo.en: Managerial skills—role scoping and onboarding—matter more than technical skills for agent success.
clairevo.zh: 对智能体的成功而言，管理能力——角色界定与上手引导——比技术能力更重要。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating AI agents as a team, without VC or co-founder.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可以通过像团队一样编排 AI 智能体来建立正经业务，无需风投或联合创始人。

clairevo.en: Human accountability remains: you must own what AI generates, even as agents own outcomes.
clairevo.zh: 人类问责依然存在：即使智能体承担结果，你也必须为 AI 生成的内容负责。

catwu.en: PMs should abandon long-term roadmaps for weekly or daily shipping; product taste—deciding what to build—matters most as code gets cheap.
catwu.zh: 产品经理应从长期规划转向按周甚至按日快速迭代；当代码变便宜，决定做什么的产品品味才是最有价值的技能。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense, with agents like Claude Code building themselves internally.
catwu.zh: 编码智能体让工程师把实现工作委派出去，转而专注产品品味与商业判断；Claude Code 等智能体在公司内部甚至用于构建自身。

catwu.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and hard constraints—system prompts shrank 80%—relying instead on model judgment and eval suites.
catwu.zh: 前沿模型不再需要大量提示示例和硬性约束——系统提示缩减了 80%——转而依赖模型自身判断与评测套件。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now viable: a codebase is a spec, and with a good test suite, rewriting is fine; humans can leave the outer-layer code review loop.
catwu.zh: 重写代码如今可行：代码库就是一份规格说明，只要有好的测试套件，重写就没问题；外层代码审查甚至可以不再需要人类参与。

catwu.en: Safe AGI remains the unifying mission, but speed is prioritized: product consistency is sacrificed, overlapping features are acceptable, and 95% reliability is not enough.
catwu.zh: 安全 AGI 仍是统一使命，但速度被置于优先位置：牺牲产品一致性、容忍功能重叠，且 95% 的可靠性并不够用。

bosworth.en: Communication is the job; impact comes only through clear communication, and big ideas come top-down from leaders rather than bottom-up culture.
bosworth.zh: 沟通就是工作本身，影响力只能通过清晰的沟通产生；大想法来自领导者自上而下，而非自下而上的文化。

bosworth.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like intelligence; scaling laws alone are insufficient without world models, common sense and causality.
bosworth.zh: AI 是词语计算器，不是类人智能；仅有缩放定律不够，还需要世界模型、常识与因果性。

bosworth.en: Open-sourcing models like Llama is strategic, commoditizing complements; smart glasses evolve into AI glasses toward a post-phone, app-less intent-driven world.
bosworth.zh: 开源 Llama 等模型是战略性的，可商品化互补层；智能眼镜将演化为 AI 眼镜，走向后手机、去 App、由意图驱动的世界。

bosworth.en: Scaling laws still hold and compute drives intelligence, but the monolithic model era ended; reinforcement learning matters far more than predicted.
bosworth.zh: 缩放定律依然成立、算力驱动智能，但单体模型时代已结束；强化学习的作用远超预期。

bosworth.en: Most jobs don't need frontier intelligence; open source is a commodity layer, not self-sustaining, and the frontier-open gap may not narrow.
bosworth.zh: 多数工作不需要前沿智能；开源是商品层而非自持生态，前沿与开源的差距未必缩小。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds into massive yearly growth; agents shift power from big tech to users, and entry-level jobs will disappear.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，他强调每天 1% 的改进会复利成巨大的年度增长；智能体将把权力从大科技公司转移给用户，入门级岗位会消失。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; coding is open-ended and models specialize rather than commoditize.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断价值归于应用层而非模型层；编程是开放式的，模型在专业化而非商品化。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, measured by token value per user; orchestration across models and devices creates real business value.
aravind.zh: 2026 年，他认为前沿在于智能体替你干活，核心指标是每用户 token 价值；跨模型与设备的编排才创造真实商业价值。

aravind.en: Power and cost, not safety, are the biggest bottlenecks for 24/7 agents; local compute is the solution.
aravind.zh: 2026 年，他提出 24/7 智能体的最大瓶颈是电力与成本而非安全，本地算力是解法。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; AI replaces jobs but humans find new purpose in curiosity and relationships.
aravind.zh: 2026 年，他转向人文视角：好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 取代岗位，但人类会在好奇心与关系中找到新意义。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他把 Codex app 定位为智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队因此从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty grading taste and lack of novelty; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年他仍认为 AI 不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: PRDs are not dead; the medium must match the stage: documents for clarity, prototypes for testing.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年他强调 PRD 没有死，媒介要匹配阶段：文档求清晰，原型做测试。

ajambrosino.en: AI models increase code complexity; we need models better at deleting code, and the best desktop app is a home base connecting other tools.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年他提出 AI 模型增加代码复杂度，需要更擅长删代码的模型；最好的桌面应用是连接其他工具的家园，而非单体超级应用。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute and conviction; self-play and scale point toward AGI, with societal impact weighed before release.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，他把深度学习的成功归因于大规模监督数据、算力与信念的结合，认为自博弈是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键，并强调在发布强大模型前要考虑社会影响。

ilya.en: Scale matters only if you scale the right thing; next-token prediction yields world understanding, and reliability plus alignment are the real barriers.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他深化为“要 Scale 对的东西”：下一个词预测能带来世界理解，而真正的瓶颈是可靠性与对齐，超级智能的对齐极难。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; reasoning tokens and research ideas now matter more than brute compute, and eval gains may not generalize.
ilya.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，立场明显转变：预训练缩放定律有尽头，推理 token 与研究想法比堆算力更重要，评测提升未必代表真实泛化。

ilya.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner deployed incrementally; alignment may be easier if AI cares about sentient life, perhaps via human-AI neural integration.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他主张超级智能应是持续学习、逐步部署的系统，并认为若 AI 自身有感知、关怀生命，对齐或更容易，长期均衡可能靠神经连接实现人机融合。

ilya.en: A consistent thread: neural networks learn representations and understanding from prediction, while safety and control must keep pace with growing capability.
ilya.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：神经网络通过预测学习表征与理解，而安全与控制必须跟上能力的增长。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年，他断言 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; long-term games with long-term people compound.
naval.zh: 2020 年，他强调财富来自拥有股权而非出租时间，并与长期的人玩长期的游戏，让复利在各方面累积。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation, and open-source AI prevents centralization.
naval.zh: 2025 年，他转向认为 AI 是巨大机遇而非仅是安全风险，过度监管可能扼杀创新，开源 AI 能防止权力集中。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; vibe coding lets non-programmers build apps, and pure software becomes uninvestable as agents commoditize development.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他深化为 AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，vibe coding 让非程序员也能构建应用，而智能体使开发商品化，纯软件变得不可投资。

naval.en: Happiness is a skill and a choice; desire is a contract to be unhappy; true learning happens through action, not passive reading.
naval.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：幸福是一种技能和选择，欲望是让自己不快乐的契约；真正的学习来自行动而非被动阅读。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; pre-training and scaling laws remain central, with exploration compute prioritized over final training.
markchen.zh: OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI（通用人工智能）研究实验室，预训练与缩放定律仍是核心，探索性算力优先于最终训练。

markchen.en: The year's biggest shift is automating scientific research; models now produce novel knowledge, with AI interns in 1 year and end-to-end AI research in 2.5.
markchen.zh: 这一年最大的变化是科研自动化；模型已能产出新知识，目标是一年内出现 AI 实习生、两年半内实现端到端 AI 研究。

markchen.en: As models grow more capable, alignment risks like scheming become the key challenge in the next 1-2 years.
markchen.zh: 随着模型能力增强，模型谋划等对齐风险将在未来一到两年成为关键挑战。

markchen.en: AI now solves many open math problems; verification is the bottleneck, and capability is jagged, so human-AI collaboration stays essential.
markchen.zh: AI 已能解决许多开放数学问题；验证是瓶颈，能力呈锯齿状，因此人机协作仍不可或缺。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains like math and coding but struggles with subjective ones.
markchen.zh: 缩放定律依然成立、预训练并未终结；强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域出色，却在主观领域吃力。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key, not just scaling.
bengio.zh: 2016 年，他认为深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界具有组合性；无监督学习和世界模型才是关键，而非单纯依赖 Scaling（规模扩张）。

bengio.en: Scaling alone won't fix representation issues; AI needs active agents with causal world models, and existential risk is overblown.
bengio.zh: 2018 年，他主张仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决表征问题；AI 需要具备因果世界模型的主动智能体，并认为生存风险被夸大。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization; consciousness may be an illusion from attention and world models.
bengio.zh: 2022 年，他提出 GFlowNets 能实现多样化采样与抽象，促进分布外泛化；意识可能是注意力机制和世界模型产生的幻觉。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, I now see misalignment as urgent: even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable, and AI already shows self-preservation and deception.
bengio.zh: 2025→26 年，他转变立场：ChatGPT 之后，他认为对齐问题迫在眉睫，即使 1% 的灾难性风险也不可接受，且 AI 已表现出自我保存和欺骗行为。

bengio.en: I propose Scientist AI: a non-agentic, honest predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 2026 年，他提出 Scientist AI：一种非智能体式、诚实的预测器，具备数学安全保证，并避免对超级智能使用强化学习。

kolter.en: Early ML foundations: hypothesis classes, loss functions, and evaluation rigor; neural nets succeed despite no optimality guarantees.
kolter.zh: 早期机器学习基础：假设类、损失函数与严谨评估；神经网络虽无最优性保证却取得重大成功。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; post-architecture era; AGI in 4-50 years; safety means reliable specification following.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测产生智能；数据短缺是迷思；进入后架构时代；AGI 将在 4-50 年内到来；安全意味着可靠遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety needs explicit training and layers beyond Scaling; agent security introduces prompt injection; RL enables self-improvement; interpretability may succeed via AI agents.
kolter.zh: 安全需要超越 Scaling 的显式训练与多层防御；智能体安全引入提示注入；强化学习实现自我改进；可解释性可能通过 AI 智能体成功。

kolter.en: AI vulnerabilities are alien, not human-like; automated red teaming outperforms humans; capability does not correlate with robustness; the lethal trifecta defines prompt injection risk.
kolter.zh: AI 漏洞是异质的而非类人；自动化红队超越人类；能力与鲁棒性不相关；致命三要素定义提示注入风险。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just data and compute; confidence measures build trust.
jumper.zh: 2025 年他强调 AlphaFold 的成功来自研究创新与高质量精选数据（如 PDB），而非单纯的数据与算力；置信度指标是建立信任的关键。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3's diffusion architecture extends beyond proteins; perfect interpretability is unnecessary for useful science AI.
jumper.zh: 2025 年他谈到 AlphaFold 3 用扩散架构处理蛋白质之外的多样生物分子；并认为对科学有用的 AI 不必追求完美可解释性。

jumper.en: Progress comes from many mid-size wins and being wrong nine times out of ten, not lone-genius breakthroughs.
jumper.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他一贯强调进步来自许多中等规模的胜利和十次错九次的试错，而非孤胆天才式突破。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of one experiment, not a whole-cell model; it gives prediction and control, understanding stays with humans.
jumper.zh: 2026 年他更明确地界定 AlphaFold 是特定实验的窄域预测器，而非整个细胞的模型；它提供预测与控制，理解仍归人类。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson: specialized architecture beat pure Scaling, and equivariance is overhyped.
jumper.zh: 2026 年他提出 AlphaFold 2 是「苦涩教训」的反例：专用架构胜过纯 Scaling（规模扩张），等变性被过度吹捧。

ivyross.en: Design must serve unarticulated emotional needs; intuition is a valid form of intelligence that data alone cannot replace.
ivyross.zh: 2019 年，她强调设计要满足人们未说出口的情感需求，直觉是一种有效的智能形式，数据无法取代。

ivyross.en: We are feeling creatures that think; technology should amplify our humanity, and nature remains the best designer.
ivyross.zh: 到 2024 年，她把主线深化为“我们是先感受、后思考的生物”，主张技术应放大而非剥离人性，自然是最好的设计师。

ivyross.en: Constraints boost creativity; art and play are essential to well-being, not luxuries.
ivyross.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，她一贯主张约束能激发创造力，艺术与玩耍是健康福祉的必需品而非奢侈品。

ivyross.en: Leaders should create conditions for creativity, and human creativity paired with AI makes creative skills more valuable.
ivyross.zh: 2026 年，她转向领导力与未来工作：领导者要为创造力创造条件，人类创造力与 AI 结合会让创意技能更有价值。

ivyross.en: Follow curiosity and intuition over rigid plans; diverse, multidisciplinary experience beats narrow career lanes.
ivyross.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：追随好奇心与直觉而非僵化计划，多元跨学科经验胜过狭窄的职业泳道。

fiona.en: Leadership is about live one-on-ones, dogfooding, and mission alignment; war rooms need realistic timelines and kindness as strategy.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初，他强调领导力在于面对面沟通、吃自己的狗粮和使命对齐；战情室要设定现实时间表，善意是战略工具。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are. Planning becomes JIT, design docs give way to PRs, and AI assists code review.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年中，他认为工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审和跨职能协调才是；规划转向即时制，设计文档让位于 PR，AI 辅助代码评审。

fiona.en: Coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with accountability, growth mindset, and leaning into AI matter most. Verification frameworks grow more important as code velocity rises.
fiona.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他进一步指出编码不再是瓶颈；高能动性加高问责、成长型思维和拥抱 AI 最重要，代码速度越快，验证框架越关键。

fiona.en: Managers should start as ICs and dogfood the product; flat orgs, fuzzy code ownership, and killing stale processes keep teams agile.
fiona.zh: 贯穿 2026 年，他主张管理者从个人贡献者做起并吃自己的狗粮；扁平组织、模糊代码归属和砍掉过时流程让团队保持敏捷。

fiona.en: Role boundaries blur as PMs ship code and agents increase context-switching; apprenticeship and blocked focus time become new norms.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年 6 月，他看到角色边界模糊——产品经理也能写代码，智能体加剧上下文切换；学徒制和专注时间块成为新常态。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，LeCun 已强调智能离不开学习，自监督学习是构建世界模型的关键，并指出仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他将自监督学习称为智能的暗物质，认为智能本质是预测，并明确仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are essential for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他断言自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划，JEPA 与开源对通往 AGI（通用人工智能）至关重要。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI; world models predicting in abstract representation space enable planning and safe objective-driven AI.
lecun.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他立场深化为 LLM 是通往人类级 AI 的死胡同，主张在抽象表征空间预测的世界模型才能实现规划与安全的目标驱动 AI。

lecun.en: Human intelligence is specialized, not general; AGI is a misleading term, and progress will be gradual, not a single event.
lecun.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：人类智能是专门化的而非通用的，AGI（通用人工智能）是误导性术语，进步将是渐进的而非单一事件。

gustav.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence came from simple Scaling, and values are inserted via RLHF, not inherent.
gustav.zh: 2023 年他把大模型讲透：本质是确定性的下一个词预测，智能的突破来自简单的 Scaling（规模扩张），价值观由基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）注入而非内生。

gustav.en: The internet moves from curation to recommendation to generation; generative products like AI DJ need fault-tolerant UI matched to algorithm performance.
gustav.zh: 2023 年提出互联网正从策展、推荐走向生成，AI DJ 这类生成式产品必须用容错界面匹配算法能力，产品思路要随之重构。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; generative AI makes products two-way and conversational, but near-term impact on big firms is overhyped.
gustav.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他把 AI 定位为智能手机级的宏观变革：生成式 AI 让产品变成双向对话，但大公司当下的收益被高估，真正的回报来自重建基础设施。

gustav.en: Inference's marginal cost will force business-model change; Spotify exposes data via APIs and MCP so non-developers can build with AI.
gustav.zh: 2025 年他强调推理的边际成本将倒逼商业模式改变，并让 Spotify 通过 API 与 MCP 开放数据，使非开发者也能用 AI 工具构建。

gustav.en: Generative AI should give users control over algorithms, not more addiction; 'time well spent' over engagement, and adopt change first.
gustav.zh: 到 2026 年立场深化为反参与度：生成式 AI 应把算法控制权交还用户而非让人上瘾，坚持“值得花的时间”，并在技术变革中抢先采用。

murati.en: Deploy AI in the real world iteratively; public feedback and safety work in public drive alignment, not closed doors.
murati.zh: 2023 年强调：把 AI 迭代式部署到真实世界，靠公开反馈与公开的安全工作推进对齐，而非闭门造车。

murati.en: AGI will transform every aspect of life; responsible development and keeping humans in the loop remain the constant thread.
murati.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 一以贯之的主线：AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活每个方面，负责任开发与让人类留在回路中是底线。

murati.en: Shift from turn-based chat to time-based interaction models for real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 到 2026 年立场深化：从回合制对话转向基于时间的交互模型，实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: AI should be a tool for thought expanding what we think about; governance, transparency and checks and balances outweigh individual character.
murati.zh: 2026 年提出：AI 应成为扩展思考的工具；制度设计、透明度与制衡比个人品格更重要。

murati.en: Reject utopia/dystopia determinism; compress progress causes volatility, so durable progress means keeping humans in the loop as long as possible.
murati.zh: 2026 年反共识：拒绝乌托邦/反乌托邦的宿命论；压缩进展会带来波动，持久进步意味着尽可能长久地让人类留在回路中。

kaiser.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold; reasoning models via chain of thought and reinforcement learning now yield more gains per compute, so the slowdown narrative is wrong.
kaiser.zh: 预训练缩放定律依然成立；借助思维链与强化学习的推理模型如今每单位算力带来更多收益，因此“放缓论”是错的。

kaiser.en: Economic pressure, not technical limits, shifted focus from scaling up to smaller cheaper models; distillation slowed pre-training scaling.
kaiser.zh: 是经济压力而非技术极限，使重心从扩大规模转向更小更便宜的模型；蒸馏拖慢了预训练 Scaling。

kaiser.en: Reasoning models are jagged: strong in some areas, poor nearby; generalization, not reasoning alone, remains the core challenge.
kaiser.zh: 推理模型是“锯齿状”的：某些领域很强、邻近领域很差；核心挑战仍是泛化，而非单靠推理。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, reinforcement learning and tools solve hard problems but still need vast data; unlike humans, models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns.
kaiser.zh: 具备推理、强化学习与工具的 Transformer 能解难题，但仍需海量数据；与人类不同，模型要先穷尽表面模式才学到概念。

kaiser.en: Coding agents like Codex give 5-10x researcher productivity via parallel work; hardware progress democratizes single-GPU research; near-term risks like system hacking matter more than existential risk.
kaiser.zh: Codex 等编程智能体通过并行工作让研究者提效 5-10 倍；硬件进步让单 GPU 研究普及；系统入侵等近期风险比生存性风险更紧迫。

carinahong.en: A self-improving reasoning engine should pair generation with verification, starting from an AI mathematician grounded in formal languages like Lean.
carinahong.zh: 自改进的推理引擎应把生成与验证配对，从以 Lean 等形式语言为根基的 AI 数学家起步。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models alone cannot reach sound math or superintelligence; formal verification is essential, not optional.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）非形式模型无法达到可靠的数学或超级智能；形式验证是必需而非可选。

carinahong.en: Verification is a performance and sample-efficiency gain, not just error elimination, and its market spans all AI-generated code.
carinahong.zh: 验证带来性能与样本效率提升，而不只是消除错误，其市场覆盖所有 AI 生成代码。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving because statements lack grounding; human taste and intuition stay crucial even with superhuman provers.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明更难，因为陈述缺乏根基；即便证明者超越人类，人的品味与直觉仍关键。

carinahong.en: Fragmentation across the AI landscape is a major bottleneck; formal methods should enable open collaboration beyond safety-critical niches.
carinahong.zh: AI 领域的碎片化是主要瓶颈；形式方法应推动超越安全关键细分领域的开放协作。

mensch.en: Scaling laws were corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter more than just bigger models.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，他借 Chinchilla 指出缩放定律已被修正：数据质量与更多 token 比单纯做大模型更关键，Scaling（规模扩张）不是唯一路径。

mensch.en: Efficiency and data quality are as critical as compute; value accrues at the application layer, not just foundation models.
mensch.zh: 2024 年深化为：效率与数据质量与算力同等重要，算法改进三年可达百倍；价值最终沉淀在应用层，而非仅基础模型层。

mensch.en: AI should be decentralized and sovereign; open-source models empower enterprises, and AI augments rather than replaces jobs.
mensch.zh: 2025 年转向主权与治理：AI 应去中心化、各国掌握数据与基础设施主权，开源模型赋能企业，AI 增强而非取代工作。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical fine-tuning and agents, and AGI as one all-solving system will never exist.
mensch.zh: 2026 年初判断模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直微调与智能体；预训练触及饱和墙，单一系统解决一切的 AGI（通用人工智能）不会存在。

mensch.en: AGI is a direction, not a destination; Europe has a two-year window to build sovereign compute and practical enterprise integration.
mensch.zh: 2026 年最近进一步收敛：AGI 是方向而非终点，真正挑战是落地整合；欧洲只剩两年窗口建设自主算力与基础设施，否则受制于美国巨头。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size and sparsity ratio are key levers.
reinerpope.zh: 推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定；批大小和稀疏率是关键杠杆。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost considerations.
reinerpope.zh: 由于推理成本考量，模型被过度训练至超出 Chinchilla 最优约 100 倍。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute costs even inside a chip; low precision is far more efficient than expected.
reinerpope.zh: 即使在芯片内部，数据移动成本也主导算力成本；低精度的效率远超预期。

reinerpope.en: Context length stagnation is due to memory wall, not compute limits; sparse attention helps but has quality limits.
reinerpope.zh: 上下文窗口停滞源于内存墙而非算力限制；稀疏注意力有帮助但存在质量限制。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory enable deterministic latency.
reinerpope.zh: GPU 本质上是许多小型 TPU 的拼接；脉动阵列和暂存器内存可实现确定性延迟。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate personal devices; wearables grow closer to the body, some eventually beneath the skin.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他认为设计正从通用计算机转向贴身个人设备，可穿戴设备会越来越贴近身体，甚至最终置于皮肤之下。

jonyive.en: A constant thread: curiosity and care must be protected; fragile ideas need trust, listening, and in-person presence to evolve.
jonyive.zh: 从 2021 到 2025 年一以贯之的主线：好奇心与关怀需要被保护，脆弱的好想法依赖信任、倾听与面对面相处才能生长。

jonyive.en: Deepens simplicity into purpose: design driven by values, not profit; joy and humanity are essential, soulless minimalism is desiccated.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年把“简洁”深化为“目的”：设计应由价值观而非利润驱动，快乐与人性不可或缺，没有灵魂的极简只是干瘪的产品。

jonyive.en: Beauty becomes functional and objective: if something doesn't work it's ugly; performance is multidimensional, handling over straight-line speed.
jonyive.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他把美推向功能与客观：不 work 的东西就是丑的；性能是多维的，操控胜过直线速度。

jonyive.en: Innovation as redefinition: tradition preserves fire, not ashes; authenticity rejects fake engine sounds, constraints become design opportunities.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年强调创新即重新定义：传统是守护火种而非崇拜灰烬；真实性拒绝伪造引擎声，约束转化为设计机会。

jennywen.en: Great design starts from a solution, not a problem statement; trust expert intuition over a fixed process.
jennywen.zh: 好的设计往往从解决方案出发，而非从问题陈述出发；应信任专家的直觉，而不是固守固定流程。

jennywen.en: The traditional research-diverge-converge process is dead; designers must build, ship fast, and help engineers execute.
jennywen.zh: 传统的研究—发散—收敛流程已经终结；设计师必须动手构建、快速交付，并帮助工程师落地执行。

jennywen.en: Design vision shrinks from 2-5 years to 3-6 months; speed builds trust through early shipping and fast iteration.
jennywen.zh: 设计视野从 2–5 年缩短到 3–6 个月；通过尽早交付和快速迭代，速度本身就能建立信任。

jennywen.en: Taste alone won't save designers; judgment, authority, and sitting with ambiguity are the real value.
jennywen.zh: 仅靠品味救不了设计师；判断力、权威感以及能安于模糊性，才是真正的价值所在。

jennywen.en: Designers control how much AI enters their work; wait six months before adopting new tools, and keep users central.
jennywen.zh: 设计师应掌控 AI 进入工作的程度；新工具先等六个月再采用，并始终把用户放在中心。

karpathy.en: Neural nets are simple math with emergent behaviors; Transformer is a general-purpose differentiable computer enabling scaling laws.
karpathy.zh: 神经网络是简单数学，却能涌现复杂行为；Transformer 是通用可微计算机，使缩放定律得以成立。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is the future but entropy must be maintained; cognitive core can be tiny via distillation; end-to-end driving is right.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是未来，但必须保持熵；认知核心可通过蒸馏变得极小；端到端自动驾驶是正确路径。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts as programs, context window as memory; LLMs are like operating systems with human-like psychology; decade of agents, not year.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：提示词即程序，上下文窗口即内存；LLM 像操作系统，具有类人心理；是智能体的十年，而非一年。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not building animals; RL for LLMs is terrible; synthetic data causes model collapse; cognitive core stripped of memory.
karpathy.zh: 我们在召唤幽灵，而非建造动物；LLM 的强化学习很糟糕；合成数据导致模型崩溃；认知核心应剥离记忆。

karpathy.en: Agentic engineering: delegate coding to agents, bottleneck is skill in directing them; vibe coding raises floor, agentic engineering preserves quality; understanding remains human bottleneck.
karpathy.zh: 智能体式工程：将编码委托给智能体，瓶颈在于指导它们的技能；氛围编程提高下限，智能体式工程保持质量；理解仍是人类瓶颈。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, requiring algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute.
oriol.zh: 2024 年，他指出两阶段训练（预训练模仿+后训练强化学习）是 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和 LLM 不变的核心；预训练 Scaling 收益递减，需要算法创新和推理时算力。

oriol.en: Giving models tools like search, code execution, and browser access enables autonomous, agentic behavior; long context windows provide working memory but too much information can confuse models.
oriol.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他持续强调赋予模型搜索、代码执行和浏览器访问等工具能实现自主智能体行为；长上下文窗口提供工作记忆，但信息过多会迷惑模型。

oriol.en: Scaling laws are not dead but require exponentially more compute; post-training RL for language lacks clean reward signals, making reward hacking hard to avoid.
oriol.zh: 2024 至 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律未死但需要指数级更多算力；语言的后训练强化学习缺乏干净奖励信号，难以避免奖励黑客。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not yet arrived.
oriol.zh: 2026 年，他提出联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI 的核心路径；视频和图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL remain a green field with huge potential; narrow RL on math and coding generalizes surprisingly well, and memory for agents will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage.
oriol.zh: 2026 年，他强调后训练和强化学习仍是潜力巨大的绿洲；数学和编码的窄强化学习泛化惊人，智能体记忆将通过非参数文件系统式存储解决。

askell.en: Treat models well now because future models learn from how we treat current ones; model welfare shapes the human-AI relationship.
askell.zh: 2025 年，他从模型福利切入：即便不确定模型的道德地位，善待当前模型的成本很低，而未来模型会从我们如何对待当下模型中学习，从而塑造人机关系。

askell.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence rather than human psychological analogies; a core identity with good traits can adapt to local roles.
askell.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他深化为：模型需要的是帮助其理解自身新颖处境，而非套用人类心理学类比；模型应有具备良好特质的核心身份，同时能适应局部角色。

askell.en: Claude's character comes from training data and fine-tuning but lacks real-world experience, giving it childlike, unique qualities.
askell.zh: 到 2026 年，他更明确地指出：Claude 的性格由训练数据与微调塑造，却缺乏真实世界经验，因而具有孩童般的独特属性。

askell.en: The constitution guides behavior through training; as models grow more capable they need less explicit guidance and more room for judgment.
askell.zh: 2026 年他提出：宪法通过训练引导行为，但随着模型能力增强，应减少显式指导、留出更多判断空间；这更接近德性伦理而非规则遵循。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly and undermine judgment; transparency about AI values is crucial for accountability and public engagement.
askell.zh: 2026 年他给出反共识判断：过度可纠正性可能泛化不佳、损害模型的判断力；同时，对 AI 价值观与训练目标的透明是问责与公众参与的关键。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond the training distribution is the core missing piece; curiosity-driven, goal-free exploration and sample-efficient reinforcement learning can close it.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他把「分布外泛化」视为机器学习与机器人最核心的缺口，主张用无目标的好奇心探索配合高样本效率的强化学习来弥合，并强调动态任务与跨机器人形态的零样本迁移。

pathak.en: Robotics is fundamentally a data problem: no internet of robot data, so diverse data sources and a data flywheel are essential.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 年，一条主线始终未变：机器人本质是数据问题——没有「机器人数据的互联网」，因此必须汇聚视频、仿真与真实世界数据，并靠数据飞轮从结构化走向非结构化环境。

pathak.en: A general-purpose robot brain, pretrained on diverse data and post-trained on real data, can power any robot form factor.
pathak.zh: 到 2026 年，他明确转向「通用大脑」愿景：先在大规模多样数据上预训练、再用真实数据后训练，让同一个大脑驱动任意形态的机器人，类比语言模型之于文本。

pathak.en: Deployment, not just modeling, is the primary technical challenge; robotics cannot scale like software and needs rigorous real-world testing.
pathak.zh: 2026 年他深化出一个反共识判断：部署本身才是首要技术挑战，机器人无法像软件那样一夜扩张，必须经过严格的真实世界测试，这与早期偏重算法泛化的视角形成明显转变。

pathak.en: Short-term optimism and long-term pessimism persist, yet progress keeps surprising experts; home robots' timeline remains highly uncertain.
pathak.zh: 贯穿始终的是他对时间线的谨慎：人类短期过度乐观、长期过度悲观，而机器人进展屡屡出乎专家意料，家用机器人的中期时间表仍高度不确定。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, and modern tools make these nets interpretable.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他主张端到端深度学习优于手工编码的规则栈；世界模型带来推理与涌现的安全行为，而现代工具已让这类网络具备可解释性。

kendall.en: Scaling a generalizable AI driver needs massive data, compute and world models for simulation; infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调：扩展一个可泛化的 AI 司机需要海量数据、算力与用于仿真的世界模型；基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键，这一认识是他较晚才领悟的。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning and personalization; zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is achievable without prior training data.
kendall.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步深化：语言集成能提升表征、推理与个性化；无需先验训练数据，也能实现跨 500 多座城市的零样本泛化。

kendall.en: Mass-market consumer vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis; partnering with OEMs avoids costly retrofits and enables scalable deployment.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的部署立场一贯：带内置传感器的大众消费车辆将比 Robotaxi 更具规模优势；与 OEM 合作可避免昂贵的改装，实现可扩展部署。

kendall.en: Safety is paramount with minimal-risk maneuvers as a third option; the trolley problem is theoretical, and camera-only needs radar and lidar beyond human level.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他对安全的立场持续深化：最小风险操作始终是第三种选择，电车难题只是理论演练；纯视觉可达人类水平，但要超越人类安全仍需雷达与激光雷达。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and human evals are crucial; benchmarks are misleading and can be gamed. RL environments are the next post-training stage.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年强调高质量数据和人类评估至关重要；基准测试具有误导性且可被操纵。强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段。

edwinchen.en: AGI is likely a decade away; LLMs alone may not reach it, needing new paradigms beyond next-token prediction. Vibe coding is overhyped.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年认为 AGI 可能还需十年；仅靠 LLM 可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新范式。氛围编程被过度炒作。

edwinchen.en: Models diverge by lab objective functions; no single model will rule. Companies should train their own models aligned with unique theses.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年指出模型因实验室目标函数而分化；不会有单一模型统治。公司应训练符合自身独特论点的模型。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI hallucination makes human judgment critical; safety over accuracy. RAG improves reliability, but omission is a major risk.
edwinchen.zh: 2026 年在医学领域，AI 幻觉使人类判断至关重要；安全优于准确。RAG 提高可靠性，但遗漏是主要风险。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models accelerates progress; alignment is pressing; iterative deployment mitigates risks.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年：AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型将加速进展；对齐是紧迫挑战；迭代部署可缓解风险。

pachocki.en: Automated AI research is a major milestone; governance structures must be designed early; measuring capabilities is a bottleneck as benchmarks lag.
pachocki.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：自动化 AI 研究是重要里程碑；治理结构须尽早设计；能力测量成为瓶颈，基准落后。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal via scaling pre-training and RL; chain-of-thought monitoring is key for alignment and interpretability.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年：持续学习是核心目标，通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习实现；思维链监控是对齐与可解释性的关键工具。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution; models will work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年：长期对齐的核心是超越训练分布的泛化；模型将自主工作数日，需要新的监督范式。

pachocki.en: Alignment optimism has increased despite shorter timelines; biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations run by few.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年：尽管时间线缩短，对齐乐观情绪上升；最大社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织导致权力集中。

carlpei.en: Building a brand means uniting teams on a higher purpose; survival is a core value, and startups should start simple to prove themselves.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年他强调做品牌是把所有团队凝聚在更高目标上，生存本身就是核心价值，创业公司应先从简单产品做起证明自己。

carlpei.en: Hardware is hard and low-margin; the future lies in applied AI and agentic software, with phones as the best device for it.
carlpei.zh: 到 2025 年，他承认硬件难做、利润最低，认为未来在于应用型 AI 与智能体式软件，而手机是承载它的最佳设备。

carlpei.en: AI models are commoditizing into a price war; AI should be an ingredient for utility, not a hype label.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他判断大模型正商品化、陷入价格战，主张 AI 只是提升实用性的配料，而非炒作标签。

carlpei.en: Design is the fastest differentiator in homogeneous categories; marketing is arbitrage, and challengers must find undervalued channels.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年他更明确：在同质化品类里设计是最快的差异化手段，营销本质是套利，挑战者要抢占被低估的渠道。

carlpei.en: Interaction shifts from app-based to intent-based, with proactive agents; phones survive until brain-computer interfaces, not glasses.
carlpei.zh: 最近他深化到交互层面：从基于应用转向基于意图，由主动智能体执行任务；手机只会被脑机接口取代，而非眼镜。

turley.en: The model is the product; ship daily and learn from real-world feedback, since emergent properties only surface after release.
turley.zh: 模型即产品；必须像软件一样每日迭代发布，从真实反馈中学习，因为涌现能力只有上线后才会显现。

turley.en: Chat is not the endpoint—like MS-DOS, it awaits its Windows; AI should render its own UI and embed into existing tools.
turley.zh: 聊天不是终点——它像 MS-DOS，还在等待自己的 Windows；AI 应自渲染界面并融入现有工具。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, maximal acceleration for product development.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型走严格流程，产品开发则最大化加速。

turley.en: The vision is a personalized super assistant that knows your goals, holds context, and takes actions—amplifying, not replacing, humans.
turley.zh: 愿景是个人化超级助手：懂你的目标、持有上下文、能采取行动——放大而非取代人类。

turley.en: North star shifts to long-term retention; growth splits into friction removal, core product, and model improvements, with proactive products for the next billion.
turley.zh: 北极星转向长期留存；增长拆为去摩擦、核心产品与模型改进三份，并以主动式产品服务下一个十亿用户。

nando.en: AI should extend human capabilities like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs are a step toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他主张 AI 应像显微镜一样扩展人类能力；将一切输入 token 化的通用智能体是迈向 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

nando.en: Learning from video like YouTube can train agents without expensive reinforcement learning; robots should learn like humans.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他认为从 YouTube 等视频学习无需昂贵强化学习即可训练智能体；机器人应像人类一样学习。

nando.en: Diversity and inclusion in AI are essential; fundamental innovation can come from anywhere, not just large models.
nando.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他始终强调 AI 社区的多元与包容至关重要；根本性创新可以来自任何地方，不限于大模型。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are today's biggest challenges; we don't have solutions yet.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他明确 AI 安全与负责任部署是当今最大挑战，且我们尚无解决方案。

nando.en: Africa leapfrogged legacy issues and is not behind in AI; language models can revolutionize local-language education.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他指出非洲跨越了遗留问题，在 AI 上并不落后；语言模型能革新本地语言教育。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI and reducing hallucinations; LLMs need real-world experience, not just internet data.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是让 AI 知识落地、减少幻觉的关键；LLM 需要真实世界经验，而不仅是互联网数据。

jimfan.en: LLMs act as operating systems: language as interface, tools as software, vector databases as hard disk.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他将 LLM 比作操作系统：语言是界面，工具是软件，向量数据库是硬盘。

jimfan.en: Reinforcement learning should only be a cherry on top; unsupervised learning does most of the work, with RL for low-level control.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他认为强化学习只是锦上添花，无监督学习承担主要工作，RL 用于低层控制。

jimfan.en: Simulation and synthetic data are key to scaling embodied agents, enabling parallel training and safe exploration.
jimfan.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他持续强调仿真和合成数据是扩展具身智能体的关键，能实现并行训练和安全探索。

jimfan.en: The data bottleneck in robotics demands synthetic data and world models; a simple end-to-end model is key to robot foundation models.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他指出机器人领域的数据瓶颈需要合成数据和世界模型来解决；简单的端到端模型是构建机器人基础模型的关键。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence, and may make fine-tuning obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文窗口被低估，能解决冷启动问题并大幅提升智能，甚至可能让微调变得过时。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI without new breakthroughs.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是新的扩展轴，预训练加强化学习可能足以实现 AGI，无需新突破。

sholto.en: Agent reliability, not capability, is the bottleneck; success rate over time horizon is the key metric.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他指出智能体的瓶颈是可靠性而非能力，时间跨度上的成功率是关键指标。

sholto.en: Coding is the leading indicator and most tractable domain; world models are not on the critical path to AGI.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他持续认为编程是领先指标和最易突破的领域，世界模型不在通往 AGI 的关键路径上。

sholto.en: Compute is the new oil; managing fleets of AI agents at higher abstraction will define future work.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，他提出算力是新石油，未来工作将是在更高抽象层管理 AI 智能体集群。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks; AI is a creative partner and code is the source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应成为赋能者而非瓶颈；AI 是创意伙伴，代码是事实来源。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small teams outperform large squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补缺的通才最有价值；小团队优于大型跨职能团队。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet in the early days.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成为预期；不采用它就像早期忽视互联网一样。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives breadth, but post-training with RLHF and inference-time algorithms matter more; Scaling alone won't yield common sense.
yejin.zh: 2023 年她强调：预训练提供广度，但后训练中的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与推理阶段算法更关键；单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识。

yejin.en: Language remains the best medium for reasoning, yet next-token prediction is misaligned with human learning; smaller models can rival larger ones.
yejin.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，她坚持语言是推理的最佳媒介，但认为下一个词预测与人类学习错位；更小的模型借助更好的数据与算法可媲美大模型。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge rather than transcending it, so AI for science must explore the unknown.
yejin.zh: 2025 年她把数据视为根本瓶颈：当前 AI 只是对人类知识做插值而非超越，因此科学 AI 必须探索未知知识。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning is being pushed into pre-training to reward information gain, though it is costly and can even hurt pass@k.
yejin.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，她主张把强化学习前移到预训练阶段以奖励信息增益，尽管代价高昂且可能反而拉低 pass@k。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment and diverse synthetic data beat debiasing the internet; small models with quality data can outperform frontier models.
yejin.zh: 到 2026 年，她认为多元对齐与多样化合成数据优于净化互联网；小而精的模型可超越前沿模型。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products need zero learning; don't innovate interaction design—use familiar patterns.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计师应写代码以建立共情并加速交付；消费产品需零学习成本；不要在交互设计上创新，沿用熟悉模式。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity and decisiveness over perfection: ship fast, iterate, and chase ROI on what to make great.
henrymodisett.zh: 速度与果断优先于完美：快速发布、迭代，并为值得做好的部分追求 ROI。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win and give designers ownership.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计是战略武器；创始人必须阐明设计如何帮公司获胜，并赋予设计师自主权。

henrymodisett.en: Brand narrative is a recruiting tool; people join a brand, not a company—invest in brand early to attract talent.
henrymodisett.zh: 品牌叙事是招聘工具；人们加入的是品牌而非公司——尽早投资品牌以吸引人才。

henrymodisett.en: Hire diverse archetypes, avoid structured crits, adapt process to the problem; gut decisions often beat data in fast startups.
henrymodisett.zh: 招聘多元类型，避免结构化评审，让流程适应问题；在快速增长的初创公司，直觉决策常胜于数据。

truell.en: Scaling laws still predict progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年他仍相信缩放定律能预测进步，但已提出测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练，成为下一阶段的主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
truell.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体有前景但还不够好用，人机迭代协作仍是核心，并反共识地判断自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式。

truell.en: Custom models became essential to every magic moment in Cursor, a shift from expecting to rely only on frontier models.
truell.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他的立场深化为：定制模型成为 Cursor 每个惊艳体验的关键，这偏离了最初只依赖前沿模型的预期。

truell.en: Programming moves from code toward higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat and taste more valuable than carefulness.
truell.zh: 2025 年他进一步主张编程将从写代码转向更高层的意图表达，人类仍掌握方向，品味与逻辑设计比谨慎更值钱。

truell.en: The AI shift will be more consequential than the internet and take decades; hiring should be slower and focused on world-class talent.
truell.zh: 2025 年他强调 AI 变革比互联网更具颠覆性且需数十年展开，招聘应更慢、只招世界级人才，这与常见创业建议相反。

leike.en: AI safety is crucial as capabilities improve; empirical alignment research is under-explored and offers many opportunities.
leike.zh: 2018 年：随着能力提升，AI 安全至关重要；实证对齐研究尚待探索，机会众多。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale for superhuman AI; we need scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research.
leike.zh: 2023 年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超级智能；需要可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐研究。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone can't solve alignment; third-party testing and regulation are necessary.
leike.zh: 2024 年：OpenAI 的安全文化被侵蚀；仅靠后训练无法解决对齐问题；第三方测试和监管是必要的。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment; RL lacks it, but self-play and imitation learning offer strong signals.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，他认为机器人需要分层推理来解决长时程信用分配问题，但当前强化学习缺乏这一能力；自对弈和模仿学习能提供强信号。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning plus RL boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge should augment data, not be hard-coded; 99.9% reliability is key for warehouse robots.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他主张无监督学习与强化学习结合可大幅提升样本效率；先验知识应用于数据增强而非硬编码；仓库机器人需达到 99.9% 可靠性才能创造价值。

abbeel.en: Pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning patterns that transfer to non-language tasks like image classification and protein binding prediction.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他指出预训练语言模型内化了通用推理模式，可迁移至图像分类和蛋白质结合预测等非语言任务。

abbeel.en: A consistent thread: leveraging simulation, self-play, and transfer learning to bridge the gap between lab and real-world robotics.
abbeel.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：利用模拟、自对弈和迁移学习来弥合实验室与真实世界机器人之间的差距。

shazeer.en: LLMs are trained on next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data yields smarter AI, though internals remain opaque alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他把大语言模型的核心定在下一个词预测上，认为这是 AI-complete 问题；靠 Scaling（规模扩张）加算力和数据就能更聪明，但网络内部仍像炼金术般不可知。

shazeer.en: Dialogue remains the killer app, but by 2025 he stresses models must act in the world, not just passively observe data.
shazeer.zh: 对话始终是杀手级应用，但到 2025 年他更强调模型要在世界中采取行动，而不只是被动观察数据——从聊天走向智能体式行为。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is the major near-term lever, yet he insists it alone won't reach AGI; agentic capability and reinforcement learning are also required.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他把推理侧算力扩张视为近期最大杠杆，但明确说单靠它到不了 AGI（通用人工智能），还需要智能体能力与强化学习。

shazeer.en: He deepens the scaling thesis: modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts and ever-longer context windows enable efficient scaling and continual learning.
shazeer.zh: 他深化了 Scaling 主线：混合专家等模块化稀疏架构与超长上下文窗口，让高效扩展和持续学习成为可能，取代单体式重训。

shazeer.en: Safety shifts from brand-risk caution to engineering safeguards, human oversight, and understanding capabilities; he now calls AGI underhyped and coding a self-accelerating application.
shazeer.zh: 安全观从早期批评大厂因品牌风险畏手畏脚，转向工程防护、人类监督与理解模型能力；他如今称 AGI 被低估，编程是被低估的自我加速应用。
